pages.title: Asian Elephant
pages.text: The Asian elephant ($(o)Elephas maximus$()) is an elephant found in the forests and grasslands of the Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia.$(br2)It is smaller than the African elephants, with smaller rounded ears and a single finger-like tip on the end of its trunk. Only some males carry large tusks.$(br2)Asian elephants live in family groups led by an older female. The species is listed as Endangered.
